title: Customer Care Plan – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses your personal information to provide disaster recovery assistance.
intro: Service NSW have developed the Customer Care Plan (the Plan) to provide disaster recovery assistance to you, your family, and/or your business. We will use the plan as a guide for our staff to ensure that they provide the information you need to recover from the disaster you are experiencing.

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my information?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects your information to provide guidance and assistance related to the disaster you are experiencing, and to provide details on potential grants, vouchers, or rebates.

faqs.q: What information might Service NSW collect?
faqs.a: Service NSW may collect your full name, and other information to provide assistance, track activities, or request participation in evaluation activities.

faqs.q: Who will Service NSW share my information with?
faqs.a: Service NSW may share your information with government agencies, their contractors, or non-government organisations who can provide assistance.
